relationships.subject: substance P
relationships.evidence_quote: Analysis of changes in neuronal activity observed in pharmacological stimulation experiments suggested that substance P induced peripheral sensitization and enhanced capsaicin sensitivity.

key_findings: HD-MEA recording of NeuO-labeled cultured DRG neurons detected five times more neurons than activity-based detection.
Substance P appeared to induce peripheral sensitization and enhance capsaicin sensitivity, mostly in neurons co-expressing TRPV1 and NK1R.
